agent_report.summary: Fixed both blocking issues from the Queen's review on PR #21 (Issue #20 — deadlines feature): (1) the mobile 360px layout where `.item-due`/`.item-urgency` squeezed `.item-text` to near-zero width, causing one-character-per-line wrapping — fixed by wrapping due+urgency into a new `.item-meta` group that drops to its own line via `flex-wrap`/`flex-basis: 100%`, scoped to `.deadlines-list` only; (2) far-out deadlines printing their due date twice — `deadlineLabel` now returns `''` beyond the 7-day window and the urgency chip is only rendered when non-empty. Added a pinning height assertion on `.item-text` at 360px, updated one existing test that relied on the now-removed duplicate label, re-captured the 360px/1280px screenshots, appended reasoning to DECISIONS.md, and confirmed all 57 tests pass. Pushed to `ant/issue-20` and answered the review on PR #21 (https://github.com/project-antfarm/antfarm-daily/pull/21); CI is running.
